notes: Alpha Bank (myAlpha Web) account movements CSV: UTF-8 WITH BOM (cashflow-report: real exports start EF BB BF), ";" separator and a trailing ";" on every line, Greek headers: Α/Α;Ημερομηνία;Αιτιολογία;Κατάστημα;Τοκισμός από;Αρ. συναλλαγής;Ποσό;Πρόσημο ποσού;. Text fields are written as Excel formulas ="…"; dates dd/mm/yyyy but the value date (Τοκισμός από) d/m/yyyy unpadded; Ποσό is UNSIGNED Greek-format ("1.550,00") and the sign is the next column: Χ (debit) or Π (credit); Α/Α numbers the lines from 1 at the newest. Firefly III says the first five lines above the header must be removed; their content is not documented and the five here (account, description, from, to, blank) are placeholders. CRLF line ends assumed. No balance; currency never stated.
